title: Overflow
tagline: A DeFi Native Credit System  that allows people to earn interest on their streaming income.
description: This project creates a native credit system for DeFi designed to allow anyone regardless of their off-chain credit score, income, etc. to access credit. This first product allows users to earn interest on streaming income using a combination of interest generated from staking and streaming powered by superfluid.
how_its_made: This project used superfluid to receive streaming collateral from investors and we used AAVE to deposit the collateral to earn interest on the investor's collateral. This allows an investor a lot of flexibility as they can earn interest on their entire investment without having to lock it all up at once.
